title:
Condition used to determine whether the current user is authorized to access the detail pages in UI.

The list of pages whose access is checked against the current user are:
1. Asset Detail Page
2. Alert Detail Page
3. Case Detail Page
4. Sensor Health Alert Detail Page
5. Protection Loop Alert Detail Page
6. Model Detail Page
7. Model - Asset Detail Page
8. Model Setup - Asset Detail Page
9. Dataset Prep - Asset Detail Page
10.Data Validation - Asset Detail Page
11.Model Configuration - Asset Detail Page
12.Dataset - Asset Detail Page

Listens to `FACILITIES_LOADED` and `CURRENT_PATH_SET` actions and deduces current page that user is navigating to.

How is authorization checked?
- Traces current page's related entity's parent {@link Facility}.
  - For example, if user is navigating to Asset Detail page, obtains {@link ReliabilityAsset}'s parent {@link Facility}.
- Checks if the current {@link User} is an authorized user for the traced parent facility.
  Treats {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#allFacilities} loaded into application state as source of truth for facilities that the current user is authorized for.

Sets {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#isUserUnauthorized} field according to the user's authorization.
This field is then used as basis in conditional renderers attached against each of the detail pages listed above to forbid users.
name: CheckUserAuthorizationEpic
